verdict.rationale: Reader has no documented export or migration feature, but its design limits lock-in. Output comes back in standard formats such as Markdown, YAML-frontmatter Markdown and JSON chunks (gh-5, gh-10). An open-source prebuilt container image lets you self-host instead of relying on the SaaS (gh-8), and fetched pages can be cached to your own S3-compatible bucket (gh-20). Configuration lives in per-request headers rather than stored jobs, so there is nothing to export, but there is also no documented export or migration tooling. Missing for 10: an explicit data/config export feature, saved job configurations in a portable format, migration documentation, and independent corroboration of portability.
